US renewables (AES Clean Energy) are built and operated under long-term PPAs; the generation table lists an offtaker and contract expiry for each facility; AES Andes long-term contracts average about 12 years remaining. Regulated US utilities (AES Indiana, AES Ohio).

NEER merchant generation (assets without long-term power sales agreements) was about 1,842 MW at 31 Dec 2023 (805 MW nuclear, mainly Seabrook, plus 1,032 MW peakers); the rest of NEER is contracted; Point Beach is labelled Contracted. Regulated FPL is the larger business.
Southern Power's average investment coverage ratio at 31 Dec 2023 was 97% through 2028 and 89% through 2033, with average remaining contract duration of about 12 years.

Millstone 2019 PPAs with Eversource and United Illuminating cover nine million MWh a year for ten years; the rest of Millstone's sales are hedged near-term. Other non-regulated generation sits in the Contracted Energy segment. Company expects about 90% of operating-segment earnings from state-regulated utilities. Millstone's total annual output (~17 TWh, so roughly half contracted) is from press, not the 10-K.
